Asian Stocks Rally Following Wall Street Rebound, Oil Prices Ease

Asian stock markets experienced a rally on Tuesday, mirroring a significant rebound in US stocks from the previous day. Japan's Nikkei 225 rose by 2.6%, and South Korea's Kospi climbed 4%, with technology stocks leading the gains. SoftBank Group shares saw an increase ahead of its earnings announcement. In contrast, Nvidia shares fell more than 6%, impacting its market value. CoreWeave's performance reportedly sparked an AI cloud stock rally and eased concerns about an economic bubble.
